80	## Round 4e — Logic cleanup: duplicates removed, panel queue survives rotation (owner plan 2026-11-01)
81	Logic round: NO visible change (no layout, colour or wording change). Source: .agents/pipeline/PLAN_DESIGN_VS_LOGIC.md sections B (L6, L8) and D. NOT in this round: the scan viewer's "W+D wks" text (a wording change, design round), demo data, anything in tests of other rounds.
82	
83	Q250 (ui/ClinicalPresets.kt) delete the unused second copy of the catalogs: `ClinicalLabPreset`, `ClinicalMedPreset`, `commonLabPresets`, `commonMedPresets` (referenced nowhere else; the lab and medication lists come from ClinicalCodexRepository). Everything else in the file stays (`COMMON_MEDICATION_FREQUENCIES`, `commonBloodPressures`, `commonVisitFindings`, `QuickPresetChips`).
84	Q251 (model/ClinicalModels.kt) ONE constant `const val MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE = "Active"` next to `MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT`. Every string literal "Active" meaning the medication status in main sources (ClinicalModels.kt, ClinicalSummaryGenerator.kt, ClinicalCommands.kt, AncState.kt, ClinicalBadges.kt, PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt, MedicationEditor.kt) is replaced by the constant; `medicationStatuses` uses it. DemoFixtures.kt is data and keeps its literals. The stored value stays exactly "Active".
85	Q252 (model/ClinicalModels.kt `ClinicalVocabulary`) ONE list `val labNamePresets = listOf("Al Borg Labs", "El Mokhtabar", "Hospital Lab", "Alfa Labs")` (same four names, same order); LabEditor.kt uses it instead of its own `listOf(...)`.
86	Q253 (model/codex/ClinicalCodexModels.kt) ONE pure function `fun nextLabPanelTest(remainingIds: List<String>, items: List<LabCodexItem>): LabPanelStep` and `data class LabPanelStep(val item: LabCodexItem?, val remainingIds: List<String>)`. It takes ids from the front of `remainingIds`, skipping ids that no longer match an item (deleted meanwhile), and returns the first match with the ids after it; `item` is null and `remainingIds` empty when nothing is left. The panel start (LabEditor.kt) stores the ids of the resolved panel tests (from `resolveLabPanel`) in the queue.
87	Q254 (ui/LabEditor.kt) the panel queue state (remaining ids, total count, current index, current item id) is kept with `rememberSaveable` so a screen rotation keeps "Test X of Y" and the remaining tests; the advance after a successful chained save calls `nextLabPanelTest`; the current item is looked up by id from the live list. No visible change, tags unchanged.
88	Static checks (.agents/checks/check_r4e.py; strip comments; main sources only):
89	 S150 none of ClinicalLabPreset, ClinicalMedPreset, commonLabPresets, commonMedPresets appear in main sources.
90	 S151 `MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE` defined once (ClinicalModels.kt); no `"Active"` literal in main sources except its definition and DemoFixtures.kt.
91	 S152 `labNamePresets` defined once in ClinicalModels.kt; LabEditor.kt references it and has no `"Al Borg Labs"` literal.
92	 S153 `fun nextLabPanelTest` defined once in ClinicalCodexModels.kt and called from LabEditor.kt; LabEditor.kt uses `rememberSaveable` and has no `mutableStateOf<List<LabCodexItem>>`.
93	Unit (JVM): NEW model/ClinicalConstantsTest.kt: MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE == "Active"; medicationStatuses exactly [Active, Completed, Discontinued, Patient non-compliant] in order; labNamePresets exactly the four names in order. NEW model/codex/LabPanelQueueTest.kt for nextLabPanelTest: normal advance keeps order, a deleted id is skipped, all ids gone -> item null and empty rest, empty input -> null, id of a renamed test still found.
94	Honest limit: rotation itself is not covered by an automated test (only the advance rule is); the owner checks it on the phone.
95	Gate: LINT-errors, whole unit suite, compile debug/release/androidTest, STATIC-r4e; emulator suite (expect 55 of 56, parked D23).

Everything else in the file stays (`COMMON_MEDICATION_FREQUENCIES`, `commonBloodPressures`, `commonVisitFindings`, `QuickPresetChips`).
Q251 (model/ClinicalModels.kt) ONE constant `const val MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE = "Active"` next to `MEDICATION_STATUS_NON_COMPLIANT`. Every string literal "Active" meaning the medication status in main sources (ClinicalModels.kt, ClinicalSummaryGenerator.kt, ClinicalCommands.kt, AncState.kt, ClinicalBadges.kt, PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt, MedicationEditor.kt) is replaced by the constant; `medicationStatuses` uses it. DemoFixtures.kt is data and keeps its literals. The stored value stays exactly "Active".
Q252 (model/ClinicalModels.kt `ClinicalVocabulary`) ONE list `val labNamePresets = listOf("Al Borg Labs", "El Mokhtabar", "Hospital Lab", "Alfa Labs")` (same four names, same order); LabEditor.kt uses it instead of its own `listOf(...)`.
Q253 (model/codex/ClinicalCodexModels.kt) ONE pure function `fun nextLabPanelTest(remainingIds: List<String>, items: List<LabCodexItem>): LabPanelStep` and `data class LabPanelStep(val item: LabCodexItem?, val remainingIds: List<String>)`. It takes ids from the front of `remainingIds`, skipping ids that no longer match an item (deleted meanwhile), and returns the first match with the ids after it; `item` is null and `remainingIds` empty when nothing is left. The panel start (LabEditor.kt) stores the ids of the resolved panel tests (from `resolveLabPanel`) in the queue.
Q254 (ui/LabEditor.kt) the panel queue state (remaining ids, total count, current index, current item id) is kept with `rememberSaveable` so a screen rotation keeps "Test X of Y" and the remaining tests; the advance after a successful chained save calls `nextLabPanelTest`; the current item is looked up by id from the live list. No visible change, tags unchanged.

 S152 `labNamePresets` defined once in ClinicalModels.kt; LabEditor.kt references it and has no `"Al Borg Labs"` literal.
 S153 `fun nextLabPanelTest` defined once in ClinicalCodexModels.kt and called from LabEditor.kt; LabEditor.kt uses `rememberSaveable` and has no `mutableStateOf<List<LabCodexItem>>`.
Unit (JVM): NEW model/ClinicalConstantsTest.kt: MEDICATION_STATUS_ACTIVE == "Active"; medicationStatuses exactly [Active, Completed, Discontinued, Patient non-compliant] in order; labNamePresets exactly the four names in order. NEW model/codex/LabPanelQueueTest.kt for nextLabPanelTest: normal advance keeps order, a deleted id is skipped, all ids gone -> item null and empty rest, empty input -> null, id of a renamed test still found.
Honest limit: rotation itself is not covered by an automated test (only the advance rule is); the owner checks it on the phone.
Gate: LINT-errors, whole unit suite, compile debug/release/androidTest, STATIC-r4e; emulator suite (expect 55 of 56, parked D23).

**Round 4e review: no Hard Blockers, 1 Should-fix, 2 Nits.**

I couldn't run `git diff` (no Bash), so I compared the current files against the spec. Nothing was compiled or run, and I haven't seen the `check_r4e.py` output.

**Hard Blockers**
- None found.

**Should-fix**
- `LabEditor.kt:172-195`: the queue advances whenever `draft.labId` changes, not on an explicit "chained save succeeded" signal. In practice `AncViewModel.kt:673-690` only creates a new draft with a new `labId` after a successful chained save, so a failed save keeps the same `labId` and does not advance.
